wikidebates-recent-changes-none: Message shown when no recent contribution is found for the debate.
wikidebates-recent-changes-author-date: Author and date displayed after a recent contribution. $1 is a wikitext link to the contributor. $2 is a date localized by MediaWiki.
wikidebates-recent-changes-history: Label of the link to the page history.
wikidebates-recent-changes-related-argum: Label shown when a recent contribution is associated with an argument. $1 is a wikitext link to the argument.
wikidebates-recent-changes-parent-proper: Exact localized name of the Semantic MediaWiki property that links an argument to its parent debate. This value is used in a database lookup and must match the property name on the wiki.
wikidebates-recent-changes-breadcrumb-pr: Exact localized name of the Semantic MediaWiki breadcrumb property. This value is used in a database lookup and must match the property name on the wiki.
wikidebates-recent-changes-error-no-page: Error shown when no debate page can be determined.
wikidebates-recent-changes-error-invalid: Error shown when the supplied debate page title is invalid.
wikidebates-recent-changes-error-no-deba: Error shown when the debate has no Semantic MediaWiki object identifier.
wikidebates-recent-changes-error-no-sema: Error shown when a required Semantic MediaWiki property cannot be found. $1 is the localized property name.
